title: Ragdoll Rush 3D: Sky Race
description: Run, jump and tumble through 25 obstacle courses across five colorful worlds! Race two computer-controlled rivals, dodge giant swinging hammers and use checkpoints to recover after a fall. Collect coins, unlock 15 outfits and upgrade your runner with a coin magnet, faster recovery and extra jump timing. Each upgrade has three tiers, and every course can be completed without upgrades. Improve your best times, earn achievements and collect a daily coin gift. Progress saves automatically. Play on desktop or mobile, in portrait or landscape, with 10 languages available.
instructions: Desktop WASD or arrow keys to move Space to jump Escape to pause Mobile drag the left joystick to move and tap the arrow button to jump Reach the finish to unlock more courses spend collected coins in the shop
tags: 1 Player, Jumping, Obstacle, Physics, ragdoll, running

title: Giant Crusher: Destroy & Grow
description: Turn a small robot into a giant wrecking machine! Smash crates and buildings with your hammer, collect coins and upgrade power, attack speed, coin earnings, movement and critical hits. Explore 12 colorful districts, defeat their bosses and unlock 17 evolutions. Recruit helpers, collect drones, complete missions and earn daily rewards. Rebirth to gain a permanent power boost and build an even stronger crusher. This single-player 3D destruction game supports desktop and touch controls, saves your progress and includes 10 languages.
instructions: Move WASD arrows or drag the touch joystick Click tap a target to approach and auto-attack Spend coins with the upgrade buttons Settings pause language music effects and fullscreen
tags: 1 Player, destruction, idle, Mobile, Robot, WebGL

title: Elemental Challenge
description: Elemental Challenge is an addictive logic puzzle game where you combine elemental pieces to create complete elements. Plan every move carefully, discover unique elemental mechanics, and find the perfect way to merge each piece. One wrong move can leave you stuck as puzzles become increasingly complex. Test your logic, strategy, and problem-solving skills, master powerful combinations, and conquer every elemental challenge!
